issues.exact_defect: The stated inequality 0<a=ε^d<ρ_d allows ε<0 when d is even. In d=2 set ε=−1/10 and T=conv{(0,0),(2,0),(0,1)}, with λ_1=x/2. The actual middle fiber contains (1,−1/20) by averaging a left and right generator point. The triangle from that point to (3/4,0) and (5/4,0) has area 1/80, lies in the cap λ_1≥1/3 and is outside T except for its base. Thus H_(1,2/3) captures strictly more than Γ+a: it fully captures the left reflected simplex, has a null right trace and exceeds Γ in the middle. The same extra middle capture occurs at L=2. The exact profile bound 1/100<ρ_2 follows from (3+9/200)^2<10.
